lines.japanese: ヤナギハラという名の都はとても賑わっていた。
lines.english: The city of Yanagihara teemed with life.

lines.japanese: 「はふん、かつての首都モルゲンでさえ、これほどの民が集まることはそうそうなかったものだが……」
lines.english: “Hah. Even Morgen, the old capital, seldom drew a crowd this large...”

lines.japanese: あまりにひとの往来が激しいものだから、私はてっきり、今日は祭りか市でも行われる特別な日なのだろうと思っていた。だが、どうやらそうではないらしい。
lines.english: People thronged the streets so thickly that I took it for a festival or market day. But no—it seemed to be an ordinary day.

lines.japanese: そしていま、大衆茶屋の前庭では──
lines.english: And now, in the forecourt of a public teahouse—

lines.japanese: 「ジーザス！　なんてこった、やっべえわこのプリン。美味すぎて俺もう、頭ハゲっかと思ったわ。よう成田君、これマジ食ってみって。これがありゃアンタも今度こそヘロインの依存から脱却できるかもしれねえぜ」
lines.english: “Jesus! Holy shit, this pudding is nuts. It’s so good I thought I was gonna go bald. Yo, Narita, you seriously gotta try it. Maybe this time you’ll finally kick your heroin habit.”

lines.japanese: 「ねねね、隼人先輩ちょっと聞きたいんだけどぉー、ほらコレ小さい『ツ』入ってンじゃないスかあ？　したらやっぱ『カフェラテください』より『カフェラッテください』っつーべきなんスか？　え、どーなんスか？」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, Hayato, I gotta ask. See how caffè latte has two t’s? Are you supposed to really hit them—say ‘lat-te’ instead of ‘latte’? Well? How’s it work?”

lines.japanese: ──フェニックスの近侍や近衛兵らが、敵陣深くへ放った索敵部隊からの報告を待っていた。
lines.english: —Phoenix's attendants and guards awaited the report of a scouting party dispatched deep into enemy territory.

lines.japanese: しかし、血の沸くような戦いの衝動──有史以前からひとの体に伝わる狩猟本能は、もはや私を出陣前の宴席に繋ぎとめておくことなど出来なかった。
lines.english: But with my blood up and that hunting instinct handed down from before recorded history stirring inside me, nothing could keep me at the feast before battle.

lines.japanese: 「嘆かわしい」
lines.english: “Lamentable.”

lines.japanese: 私はひとり豆煮汁の椀を置き、席を立ち、帷幕を離れて歩きだした。
lines.english: I set down my bowl of bean broth, rose alone from my seat, and departed the pavilion.

lines.japanese: 「たるんでおる……敵も味方も、兵も市民も、いくさを前にしながら皆たるみきっておるわ。ほんに嘆かわしいことよ。時の流れを感じずにはおれぬ。のうスノウマン。おい、聞いているのかスノウマン」
lines.english: “No discipline... Enemy or ally, soldier or civilian, the lot of them have gone soft with a battle ahead. Truly lamentable. Times have changed. Don’t you agree, Snowman? Snowman, are you listening?”

lines.japanese: 「聞いているのかスノウマァァァン！！」
lines.english: “Are you listening, Snowmaaaaaan?!”

lines.japanese: 「んノオオーっ！　なにやってんだァ成田君！？」
lines.english: “Nnnoooo! What the hell are you doing, Narita?!”

lines.japanese: 「蹴んなよ！　雪だるま蹴んなよ！　いい歳して阿呆スかあんた、警察呼ばれますよ！」
lines.english: “Quit kicking it! Don't kick the snowman! You're a grown man, you moron. Somebody's gonna call the cops!”

lines.japanese: 「ぬうっ、離せ、離さぬか無礼者ども！　ええい、スノウマン、こやつらを引きはがせ！　そなたのブリザード・ブレスで頭を冷やしてやるのだ！　早ようせい、どうしたスノウマン、このゴブリン脳め！」
lines.english: “Nngh! Let me go! Unhand me, you insolent curs! Snowman, pull them off me! Cool their heads with your Blizzard Breath! Quickly! What’s wrong with you, Snowman, you goblin-brained fool?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　そ、そうかスノウマン。さてはおぬし、石化の術を喰らって……そうだったのか、すまぬ、余は無力な王ぞ……」
lines.english: “Ah! I-I see, Snowman. You were struck by a petrification spell... So that’s it. Forgive me. What a powerless king I am...”

lines.japanese: 「あ～あ～、もう、なに昼間っから飲んでンだよ……つか酔っぱらった隼人先輩って初めて見るけど、意外にっつーか、相当タチ悪りーんスね」
lines.english: “Aw, come on. What’ve you been drinking in the middle of the day? I’ve never seen you drunk before, Hayato. I was gonna say you’re worse than I expected, but you’re a total nightmare.”

lines.japanese: 「む、なんだと小癪な小僧め。良いか、俺はファルコンにあらず、俺を成田と呼ぶな。俺は偉大なるガルーダ、現世での名を銘ずるなら伊丹伽楼羅だ。おい、聞いているのかスノウマン」
lines.english: “Hm? What did you say, impudent boy? Listen well: I am not Falcon. Do not call me Narita. I am the great Garuda. If you need my name in this world, it is Karura Itami. Snowman, are you listening?”

lines.japanese: 「聞いているのかスノウマァァァン！！」
lines.english: “Are you listening, Snowmaaaaaan?!”

lines.japanese: 「だから！　蹴ンなよ雪だるまを！」
lines.english: “That's what I'm saying! Quit kicking the snowman!”

lines.japanese: 待機中の我らが軍勢に、民間人たちが奇異の目を向けてゆく。支配されることに慣れてしまい、抗うための爪牙を失った彼らは、瞳の色すら濁った灰色に近かった。
lines.english: Civilians cast strange looks at our waiting army. Long accustomed to being ruled, with no claws or fangs left to fight back, even their eyes had dulled to something near gray.

lines.japanese: かくのごとき灰色の視線を浴びて、我が隊の士官や兵士たちはいささかの冷静さを欠いていた（多くのひとからじろじろと見られれば誰だって落ちつかないものです）。
lines.english: Bathed in those gray gazes, the officers and soldiers of my force lost some measure of composure. (Anyone would feel unsettled with so many people staring.)

lines.japanese: 「なァー皇帝ー、これヤベエってー。やっぱ俺らメタメタ浮いてンよ、店のやつも通行人も、みんなこっちチラ見してんじゃん」
lines.english: “Hey, Emperor, this is bad. We stick out like a goddamn sore thumb. The staff and everybody walking by keep sneaking looks at us.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 左右を屈強な護衛兵で固めたフェニックスは、長すぎる足を卓上に放りだして深々と座していた。
lines.english: Flanked on either side by strapping guards, Phoenix lounged deep in his chair, his excessively long legs flung across the table.

lines.japanese: 「そうかァ？」
lines.english: “You think?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、当たり前じゃないスか！　こんな明るいうちから俺らみたいのが集まって、オープン席まるっと占拠してんスよ。そらぁ人目引きますって」
lines.english: “Well, obviously! A bunch of guys like us get together in broad daylight and take over the whole patio—of course people are gonna stare.”

lines.japanese: 「ったくよー皇帝、オメ、なんでこんな時間にいきなり集合かけんだよー」
lines.english: “Seriously, Emperor, why'd you suddenly call everybody out at this hour?”

lines.japanese: 「くどい。俺じゃないと言ったろう」
lines.english: “Enough. I told you I wasn’t the one who called you here.”

lines.japanese: 「説明したはずだぞ。おまえらのプレジデントは今日からその男──伊丹伽楼羅だ」
lines.english: “I explained this already. Starting today, your president is that man—Karura Itami.”

lines.japanese: 「いやプレジデントつったって……」
lines.english: “Yeah, but you say 'president'...”

lines.japanese: 「伊丹ナンタラつったって……」
lines.english: “Yeah, but ‘Itami Whatshisname’...”

lines.japanese: 「だってアレ……」
lines.english: “I mean, that’s...”

lines.japanese: 「明らかにアレ……」
lines.english: “He’s obviously...”

lines.japanese: 「成田君じゃん……」
lines.english: “That’s Narita...”

lines.japanese: 「ふむん？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 兵たちの視線が注がれていることに気付き、私はスノウマンとの綿密な作戦会議を中断させて腰を上げた（ちなみに彼はまるで雪像のように寡黙な男で、ほとんど議事進行を妨げることがありませんでした）。
lines.english: Noticing the soldiers' eyes upon me, I suspended my detailed war council with Snowman and rose. (He was a taciturn man, much like a statue made of snow, and almost never obstructed the proceedings.)

lines.speakerEn: Man with His Hair Tied Back
lines.japanese: 「ヤーマン！　お待たっ、せー！」
lines.english: “Yeah, man! Sorry to keep ya waiting!”

lines.japanese: そこへ、髪をつむじの辺りで結った男が駆けこんでくる。
lines.english: At that moment, a man with his hair tied near the crown of his head came running over.

lines.japanese: 男のまとった色鮮やかな染物からは、灰と緑の混じった独特の香りが立ちのぼっている。日常に灸やハーブが溶けこんでいる生活──おそらく薬草術の心得があるのだろう。
lines.english: His brilliantly dyed clothes smelled strangely of ash and green leaves. A man who lived among moxa and herbs, I thought, must know a thing or two about medicinal plants.

lines.japanese: 「ぶっはー！　見っけた見っけた、成田チャンのお望み通り、生きのイイ子ら見つけちった！」
lines.english: “Phew! Found 'em, found 'em! Just like Narita wanted—I found us some nice lively ones!”

lines.japanese: 「おおマジか、ナイスだチケドン」
lines.english: “Oh, for real? Nice one, Chikedon.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……どこにいた」
lines.english: “Oh...? Where?”

lines.japanese: 「花水木通りにさあ、オアシスってホールあんじゃーん？　あっこでいま、Ｒ－ウィングの下っ端が三人、スロット打ってた」
lines.english: “You know that hall called Oasis on Dogwood Street? Three R-Wing grunts are playing the slots there right now.”

lines.japanese: 「へえー、まだしばらくいそうな感じなんスか？」
lines.english: “Oh. Look like they'll be there awhile?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、今うちのチームのインフルエンザとエキノコックスに見張らせてんだけど、そいつン台、調子よさげだったしね～。まあ、ありゃしばらくは動かねンじゃないかな～あと」
lines.english: “Yeah. Influenza and Echinococcus from my team are watching them now, and the dude's machine looked like it was running hot. So, yeah, I don't think he'll move for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: フェニックスが歯を剥いて笑った。私は薬草師のような男に訊いた。
lines.english: Phoenix bared his teeth in a grin. I asked the man who looked like an herbalist a question.

lines.japanese: 「ホール。ホールとな。おい、ホールとはなんだ。そうか、穴だな。かつて精霊界の住人が物質界との往来に用いたと伝承にいわく、あのムルグの大穴のことか」
lines.english: “A hall? What is a hall? Ah—a hole! The Great Hole of Murg, then? Legend says the spirits once used it to pass between their realm and the world of matter.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　いや、ただのパチ屋だけど」
lines.english: “Huh? No, just a pachinko parlor.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「うわあ、隼人先輩って、酔うとギャグがオタ臭くなるんスね」
lines.english: “Wow. So when you get drunk, even your jokes turn all nerdy.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「しかもネタ古りーよ。ムルグの大穴ってアレだろ、ウイングクエストのⅠだろ。俺ら小坊ンころのロープレじゃん」
lines.english: “And dated as hell. The Great Hole of Murg was from *Wing Quest I*, right? That's an RPG from when we were in grade school.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「アそだ、たしかウイクエのⅠって、プリンセスの名前、自分で好きに変えられる裏ワザあったッスよね。ふひひ、隼人先輩ってさあ、クラスの気になる女子の名前とかこっそり付けちゃうタイプだよね」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah! Wasn’t there a trick in *Wing Quest I* that let you give the princess any name you wanted? Heh-heh. Hayato, you’re totally the type who’d secretly name her after a girl you had a crush on in class.”

lines.japanese: <-4>\「Ｈｕｈ、そうだな、そんで忘れたころ友達に貸してうっかりバレちまうタイプだな」
lines.english: “Huh. Yeah, then after you'd forgotten all about it, you'd lend the game to a friend and get busted.”

lines.japanese: 近侍たちがなにやら囁きあっているのをよそに、私はひとり精霊界へ旅するという壮大な夢想に耽った。しかし精霊界とはどのような場所やら想像に難かったので、大穴の門番ゴーレムを倒したところで打ちきった。
lines.english: While the attendants whispered among themselves, I drifted into a grand fantasy of traveling to the spirit realm. But I could not imagine what the place looked like, so I ended the adventure just after defeating the golem guarding the Great Hole.

lines.japanese: 「チケドン、目標をバラけさせて、一体だけ路地裏へ誘いこめ。出来るな」
lines.english: “Chikedon. Split up the targets and lure one of them into an alley alone. Can you do it?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　ああ、そうねえ……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, sure...”

lines.japanese: 薬草師のような毛深い男は、命じられた作戦の概要をしばし吟味してから軽快に頷いた。
lines.english: The hairy man who resembled an herbalist considered the assigned plan for a moment, then nodded breezily.

lines.japanese: 「アイリー。じゃあ、囲い込み用に五人ばかし連れてくよん」
lines.english: “Irie. Okay, I’ll take five or so to box them in.”

lines.japanese: 「任せる。次、スペランカー」
lines.english: “I leave it to you. Next—Spelunker.”

lines.japanese: フェニックスは薬草師のような男を下げ、代わって炭鉱夫のような防塵マスクの男を呼んだ。
lines.english: Phoenix dismissed the man I had taken for an herbalist and called over another who wore a miner’s dust mask.

lines.japanese: 「捜索中の全チームに通達しろ。雑魚はもういい、狙いをカラス一匹に絞れ。ただし目標を捕捉しても手は出すな。鳳翔から愉快なショウの誘いがあると伝え、俺の三番ケータイにかけさせろ。さて……」
lines.english: “Send word to every search team. Forget the small fry. Narrow the hunt to the Crow alone. If you locate the target, do not engage. Tell him Kakeru Otori has invited him to an entertaining show, and have him call my third phone. Now then...”

lines.japanese: そこまで告げると、彼は卓の上に載せていた長過ぎる足を下ろして席を立った。円を描くように首を回して私に目を向ける。
lines.english: Having said this much, he lowered his overly long legs from the table and rose. He rolled his neck in a circle and turned his eyes upon me.

lines.japanese: 「クク、血に飢えた王よ、場所を変えよう。罠に追いこんだ獲物を仕留めるのはおまえの役目だ」
lines.english: “Heh. Bloodthirsty king, let’s change venues. Once we drive the prey into the trap, it’s your job to finish it.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、ついに出立のときが来てしまったか。いざとなると名残惜しいものであるな。ふたたび永き別れになるやもしれぬ。だが古き友よ、これが今生の別れではあるまい、いずれ久闊を叙す日の訪れんことを」
lines.english: “Oh. So the hour of departure is upon us. Strange how hard it is to part when the moment comes. Perhaps we shall be separated for many years again. But old friend, surely this is no farewell forever. May we meet one day and speak of all that has passed.”

lines.japanese: 私はスノウマンにしばしの別れを述べ、静かなる男に背を向けた。彼はおそらく泣いているだろう。雪国の男はみな防寒目的で股間に豊かな体毛を蓄えているものの、意外や心の機微には敏感でとても涙もろいのだ。
lines.english: I bade Snowman farewell for now and turned my back on the silent man. He was probably weeping. Men of the snow country grow thick hair about their loins to ward off the cold, yet they are surprisingly attuned to the subtleties of the heart, and quick to tears.

lines.japanese: 「さらばスノウマン、我はいざ行かん！　フェニックス、とく案内せよ！」
lines.english: “Farewell, Snowman! I go forth! Phoenix, lead the way at once!”
